coll: the term of the contract / lease — 合約、租約的期限
terms and conditions — 條款與條件(永遠複數)
in the short / long term — 短期 / 長期來看

ex.en: The term of the lease is three years, renewable upon mutual agreement.
ex.zh: 本租約期限為三年,雙方同意後可續約。

ex.en: Please review the terms and conditions carefully before signing.
ex.zh: 簽署前請仔細審閱條款與條件。

ex.en: Outsourcing may be cheaper in the short term, but it raises costs later.
ex.zh: 委外在短期內可能較便宜,但之後會墊高成本。

pos: n. 期限、期間(the term of the contract 合約期間)
root: 拉丁 terminus(界限、終點),跟 terminal、terminate、determine 同家族 —— 航廈是航程的終點,合約的 term 是那條到此為止的界線。
tip: 單數 term = 期限,複數 terms = 條款,只差一個 s,是多益最愛的陷阱。
zh: 合約期限;複數 terms = 條款
